hypotheses: Joint zone/shotType/move references improve on marginal averaging
Unclipped affine interval score and absolute error retain their intended target
Five whole-game reference folds remove own-game label contribution from training tools

reward.invalid: -2.0 for invalid tools, nonfinite/bool numbers, missing/extra fields, empty/long reason or invalid interval ordering
reward.pointTarget: conditional median of official shot quality, not personal make probability
reward.groundingScope: numeric consistency only; not semantic accuracy certification

referenceFolds.train: exclude every shot in the current episode game fold

secondary: interval score on identical valid examples with valid-rate reported
selection.baseline: same episode IDs with joint median+20/80 quantiles, marginal tables and Claude with same v4 tools

evaluationLimit: Existing H2H and league sets have been used for development/selection; do not label final results as untouched-test generalization or an information ceiling.
